# search_tracks { #geneinfo.ucsc.search_tracks }

```python
geneinfo.ucsc.search_tracks(*queries, assembly, label_wrap=80)
```

Print tracks matching fuzzy queries (or all tracks when no query given).

Each output line is a track name followed by its long label. Names are
matched word by word with fuzzy string matching, and tracks matching
more of the words, more closely, are listed first.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[***queries**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [()]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Search terms. Each is split into words; a track's score is the sum of its best fuzzy-match scores across all words.

<code>[**assembly**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Genome assembly, e.g. ``'hg38'``.

<code>[**label_wrap**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [80]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Width at which each track's long label is wrapped.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If ``assembly`` is ``None``.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from geneinfo import ucsc
>>> ucsc.search_tracks('recombination', assembly='hg38')
```
